name: Biscuits
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour(Maida) (49.8%), Wheat Flour(Atta) (18%), Edible Vegetable Oil(Palm Oil), Sugar, Wheat Bran(3.2%), Invert Sugar Syrup, Raising Agents [INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii), INS 450(i)], Iodised Salt, Malt Extract, Emulsifiers(INS 322, INS 472e), Acidity Regulator (INS 296), Dough Conditioner (INS 223). Contains Cereals containing gluten (Wheat), Soy and Sulphite. May contain Milk and Nuts
